items.headline: Twelve residential plots listed in Dubai for 963 million dirhams
items.summary: A new batch of residential land has been put up for sale in Dubai. The total valuation for these twelve plots reaches nearly one billion dirhams.
items.why: It highlights major land supply entering the market.
items.impact_reason: Significant land supply offering future development potential.

bullets: On Monday 19 October, DLD recorded 702 sales worth AED 1.7bn, down 3.1% compared to a typical weekday.
Off-plan share reached 69.2%, compared to 65.2% over the last 7 days.
The median price was AED 1,720 per sq ft, up 4.3% over the last 30 days and 1.0% compared to last year.
Over the last 7 days, the busiest areas were Dubai South (DWC) with 290 sales, JVC with 188 sales, and Majan with 126 sales.
In September new rental contracts, JVC 1-bedroom apartments had a median rent of AED 69,000 a year, up 3.2% on the month.
talking_points: The Dubai property market is becoming more selective, with buyer focus turning towards value.
Twelve residential plots have been listed in Dubai for 963 million dirhams, highlighting major land supply entering the market.
Arada Developments has announced a 180 million dollar tender offer cap, reflecting corporate financial maneuvers by a major regional developer.

items.headline: Dubai completes 104 projects worth $29.3 billion in H1 2026
items.summary: The sector saw major handovers totaling billions of dollars during the first half of the year. This reflects strong construction delivery across the emirate.
items.why: It shows significant completed supply entering the market, impacting inventory levels.
items.impact_reason: Highlights major completed supply entering the market.
